newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks shoot up 13.2 pct in bullish market.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks shoot up 13.2 pct in bullish market.

text.p: Dhaka stocks soared to an unprecedented high in an extrimely bullish market propelled by euphoric trading by both small and institutional investors, brokers said.
The Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) all-share price index rose 183.72 points or 13.2 perccnt at 1,574.56 on a turnover of 262 million taka. Friday is the weekend in Moslem Bangladesh.
Of the total 130 issues traded 116 closed higher, 10 ended lower and four remained unchanged.
Beximco Pharmaceuticals rose 53.23 taka to 148.32, Bata Shoe Co gained 15.9 to 174.74 and Bangladesh Tobacco Co was up 52.83 to 237.54.

"The investors have just gone crazy. They have bought at whatever prices asked by the sellers. I don't see any other reason other than the relatively peaceful political atmosphere, said Abdul Malek of Abndul Rashid & Co.
He said most weighted shares gained in the trading and they had a "very deep influence" on the price index.
